verdict.rationale: Installation method is a fair axis for a desktop LLM app, but the evidence pack never mentions prebuilt installers, binaries, or package-manager distribution. The only install-related item (jan-gh-7) describes a from-source build script that installs dependencies, builds core components, and launches the app, which is the opposite of the story. The other items cover features, not distribution, so this is an applicable capability with no supporting evidence.
